title: Imperatle empire
description: One empire of the game. The file name must be <slug>.json.

slug.description: Stable id: lowercase words separated by hyphens, e.g. "mongol-empire". Never change it after launch (players' history points to it).

name.description: Name shown in the guess list and in the answer.

peak.description: Year of the greatest territorial extent, the moment the map shows. The era clue is computed from it.

durationNotes.description: Optional caveat shown next to the duration, e.g. which phase of a longer state the dates cover.

religionNotes.description: Optional caveat shown next to the religion, e.g. that most subjects followed other faiths.

area.description: Largest area ever controlled (same moment as peak).

mapAccuracy.description: How well historians know the borders on the map: Precise (High), Approximate (Medium), Speculative (Low).

continents.description: Every continent where the empire held territory at its peak.

primaryContinent.description: Where most of the territory was. Must be one of continents.

language.description: Main language of the government and the elite.

religion.description: Official religion, or that of the ruling elite.

curiosities.description: Exactly 3, from the least obvious to the most obvious. They're revealed in this order.

map.description: Optional while the map isn't ready (the game shows a placeholder).

file.description: File name inside apps/web/public/maps: a neutral code (10 lowercase hex characters), never the empire's name, e.g. "3fa9c01b2d.webp".

sourceUrl.description: Page where the map came from (e.g. its Wikimedia Commons page).

year.description: Negative = BCE, as historians write it: -27 is 27 BCE. There is no year 0.

precision.description: Exact, Approximate (circa) or Century (only the century is known).
